from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and which OTHER provided papers it references or is cited by."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list/bibliography")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their works")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
